name: β-methyl-2C-B
summary: β-Methyl-2C-B (BMB), also known as 4-bromo-2,5-dimethoxy-β-methylphenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and 2C families related to the BOx drugs. It is the β-methyl derivative of 2C-B and a structural isomer of DOB (α-methyl-2C-B), but is less potent than either of these drugs.

pharmacology.text: It has two possible enantiomers but their activity has not been tested separately.

summaryZh: β-甲基-2C-B（英語：β-Methyl-2C-B，縮寫BMB）是一種有機化合物，化學式為C11H16BrNO2，它是布苯丙胺的同分異構體和2C-B的同系物，能作為迷幻藥物。
